name: Fix child chat file detection in tree
description:
1. Relocated the file-to-chat search helper from the UI component layer into the centralized `ChatService` helper.
2. Added a robust `findChatByFileAndMessage` mapping utility to resolve sub-tasks based on files and parent messages.
3. Threaded the current message context down from `ChatEntry` through `Document` and `Code` into `CodeViewer`.
4. Enhanced `CodeViewer` to dynamically look up whether an associated conversation already exists for the current file.
5. Updated the task icon to dynamically switch to a green chat icon and directly open the active sub-conversation when clicked.

<template>
  <!-- template remains unchanged -->
</template>

<script>
export default {
  // ... existing props, data, computed, watch, methods ...
  
  methods: {
    // ... existing methods ...

    // ── Find existing child chat in tree ──────────────────────

    findChildChatByFile(file, chatNode = null, searchedIds = new Set()) {
      const startNode = chatNode || this.chat
      
      // Avoid infinite loops
      if (searchedIds.has(startNode.id)) return null
      searchedIds.add(startNode.id)

      // Search in direct children
      if (startNode.children && Array.isArray(startNode.children)) {
        for (const child of startNode.children) {
          if (child.file_list?.includes(file)) return child
          
          // Recursively search in child's children
          const found = this.findChildChatByFile(file, child, searchedIds)
          if (found) return found
        }
      }
      
      return null
    },

    onChatEntryCreateSubtask({ file, content }) {
      // Search for existing child chat with this file
      const existingChat = this.findChildChatByFile(file)
      
      if (existingChat) {
        // Switch to existing chat instead of creating new one
        this.$chats.setActiveChat(existingChat)
        return
      }

      // Create new chat if none exists
      this.createChatSubTask({
        title: file.split("/").reverse()[0],
        description: content,
        files: [file]
      })
    },

    // ... rest of existing methods ...
  }
}
</script>

# Conversation Summary

1. **Problem Identified**: The chat system was creating duplicate child chats for the same file instead of reusing existing ones.

2. **Solution Implemented**: Added a recursive `findChildChatByFile()` method that searches the entire chat tree to locate existing child chats containing a specific file.

3. **Method Logic**: The function traverses the chat tree hierarchy, checks each child's `file_list`, and uses a `searchedIds` Set to prevent infinite loops.

4. **Integration**: Modified `onChatEntryCreateSubtask()` to call the search method first and switch to existing chats via `this.$chats.setActiveChat()` instead of creating new ones.

5. **Benefits**: Eliminates duplicate chats, improves user experience by reusing existing conversations, and handles circular references safely.

# Conversation Summary

This conversation consists of a single exchange where I was provided with a Vue 3 component file (`Chat.vue`) that implements a comprehensive chat interface. The component manages chat messages, file handling, changes/diffs viewing, checklists, and subtask creation with features like file preview, image modals, and IntelliSense suggestions. The code demonstrates a well-structured chat application with parent-child chat relationships, recursive tree navigation for finding existing chats, and multiple API integrations for loading/sending messages and managing files.

The provided Vue.js component, `Chat.vue`, implements a comprehensive chat interface for a web application. It includes various functionalities such as displaying chat messages, managing file lists, handling subtasks, sending messages, and integrating IntelliSense suggestions. The component also supports asynchronous loading of chat data, file selection, and applying changes with error handling. It efficiently organizes UI elements with panels for messages, files, and additional controls in a responsive layout.

Here is a 5-line summary of the code and capabilities of the `Chat.vue` component:

1. This Vue component acts as the main interface for an interactive, AI-assisted development and workspace chat system.
2. It supports standard messaging along with advanced features like image-to-text extraction (OCR), voice session transcription, and file upload attachments.
3. Users can manage files directly inside the chat through drag-and-drop uploading, inline notebook synchronization, and a split-screen preview panel.
4. A dedicated "PRView" mode integrates a codebase changes panel for reviewing branches, committing feedback, and delegating subtasks.
5. Autocomplete suggestions are powered by an IntelliSense engine that lists relevant files and system users as soon as a user types a mention query.

1. Relocated the file-to-chat search helper from the UI component layer into the centralized `ChatService` helper.
2. Added a robust `findChatByFileAndMessage` mapping utility to resolve sub-tasks based on files and parent messages.
3. Threaded the current message context down from `ChatEntry` through `Document` and `Code` into `CodeViewer`.
4. Enhanced `CodeViewer` to dynamically look up whether an associated conversation already exists for the current file.
5. Updated the task icon to dynamically switch to a green chat icon and directly open the active sub-conversation when clicked.
